summary.name: Advanced R
summary.one_liner: Online companion site for the 2nd edition of "Advanced R", Hadley Wickham's book on R programming skills and language internals.
keywords: r book for other language programmers
use_cases: Understanding why R works the way it does
Learning R coming from another programming language
Reading a free online R programming book
Finding companion resources for R study
summary.what_it_does: ["Hosts the website for the 2nd edition of the book Advanced R, part of Chapman & Hall's R Series.", "Aimed primarily at R users who want to deepen their programming skills and understanding of the language.", "Also intended for programmers coming to R from other languages, explaining the reasons behind R's design.", "Points to related books: Advanced R Solutions (worked exercise solutions), R for Data Science, and R Packages.", "Book content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the code is also available under the MIT license."]
notable: Written by Hadley Wickham and built with bookdown
Code samples are MIT licensed and can be reused in your own packages with citation
Covers why R works the way it does, not just syntax
caveats: Book text is licensed for non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
The 1st edition is hosted separately at a different address
